def recite(start, take=1):
    words = [
        "no", "one", "two", "three", "four",
        "five", "six", "seven", "eight", "nine", "ten"
    ]

    verses = []
    for n in range(start, start - take, -1):
        # First two lines: capitalized number word at start
        first_word = words[n].capitalize()
        bottle_plural = "bottle" if n == 1 else "bottles"
        line1 = f"{first_word} green {bottle_plural} hanging on the wall,"
        line2 = line1

        # Third line is constant
        line3 = "And if one green bottle should accidentally fall,"

        # Fourth line: next count (n-1), lowercased word; use singular/plural appropriately
        next_n = n - 1
        next_word = words[next_n]
        next_plural = "bottle" if next_n == 1 else "bottles"
        line4 = f"There'll be {next_word} green {next_plural} hanging on the wall."

        verses.append("\n".join([line1, line2, line3, line4]))

    return verses
```
